title: Bloom Filters
subtitle: A few bits per key answer 'definitely not here' cheaply, if you size them for the keys you will really store
motto: Be sure about no, and only guess about yes
coreAddition: Bloom filter in front of a store
keyInsight: A Bloom filter never misses a present key and rarely wastes a lookup on an absent one, but it cannot grow, so it must be sized for the final key count.

decisions.title: Measure the false-positive rate on real keys
decisions.description: The sim inserts keys and probes keys that were never inserted, then prints the theory beside the measurement so the formula is checked.
decisions.alternatives: Quoting the formula alone would not show that the observed rate matches it.

decisions.title: Fail by over-filling
decisions.description: The failure frame adds three times the planned keys, because a Bloom filter cannot resize and silently degrades when the key count is underestimated.
decisions.alternatives: Showing only a well-sized filter would hide the most common production mistake.
